errors.text: The predicted phase constitution is predominantly BCC or unspecified dual phase, whereas the target result is predominantly FCC with approximately 83% FCC and 17% BCC.

The intervention conditions materially diverge from the target: 10:1 rather than 20:1 ball-to-powder ratio, 400-600 rather than 400 rpm, a different SPS heating schedule, and omission of the mold diameter.
The initial state incorrectly allows an as-cast, micrometer-grained, FCC material even though the target starts from nominally equimolar elemental powders.
The predicted hardness of 450-600 HV excludes the observed approximately 675 HV, and the predicted strength is far below the approximately 1894 MPa compressive strength.

Low-load Vickers testing by itself cannot isolate grain-boundary strengthening from precipitation hardening; independent grain-size and precipitate-fraction measurements or matched microstructural controls are required.
